policy: seller claims are not independently established efficacy; no deployed merchant URL, pixels, redirects or CMS writes

claims.claim: The 1999 study investigated sustained inattentional blindness for unexpected dynamic events
claims.limits: Lab tasks, not every viewing condition

claims.claim: Likelihood of noticing varied with unexpected object's similarity to other objects
claims.limits: Conditional experimental finding

claims.claim: Monitoring task difficulty influenced unexpected-event detection
claims.limits: Not a generalized ability measure

claims.claim: Spatial proximity to attended location did not guarantee detection
claims.limits: Does not mean gaze does not matter in any circumstance

claims.claim: Some participants did not report a fully visible gorilla
claims.limits: Do not quote a universal percentage without condition

claims.claim: A 2010 follow-up included a gorilla, curtain-color change and player departure
claims.limits: New video not identical original

claims.claim: Familiarity with famous demo did not improve detection of other unexpected events in that task
claims.limits: Not proof warnings never help

claims.claim: Selective ignoring and stimulus similarity affect inattentional blindness
claims.limits: Task-specific effect

claims.claim: Inattentional blindness proves humans have no conscious awareness of surroundings
claims.limits: Overgeneralization

claims.claim: An unseen gorilla proves people are dishonest witnesses
claims.limits: Reporting error != fraud

claims.claim: Zen12 helps users notice gorillas or improves inattentional blindness
claims.limits: No independent Zen12-specific trial found for this outcome

claims.claim: Meditation automatically improves all attention tasks
claims.limits: No justified universal claim

claims.claim: Existing public FV change-blindness article dates to Nov 2, 2026
claims.limits: Keep canonical separate; avoid keyword cannibalization

claims.claim: Published Puységur archive preserves image-locked provenance, case dossiers and failures
claims.limits: Historical sources do not verify mesmerism mechanism

claims.claim: FV 52-page Focus Fieldbook is offered free with existing Dispatch subscription
claims.limits: No independent intervention trials of fieldbook

claims.claim: Inspire3 catalogs Zen12, Hypnosis Live, Brainwave Shots and other products
claims.limits: Catalog alone does not give affiliate permission

claims.claim: Zen12 offers twelve-minute audio sessions
claims.limits: No tested intervention benefit inferred

claims.claim: Zen12 website lists twelve levels in full course
claims.limits: Verify precise referred SKU

claims.claim: Zen12 premium full course lists forty-eight MP3s
claims.limits: Other packages differ

claims.claim: Zen12 lists guided meditation, relaxation music, sounds of nature, and white noise
claims.limits: No first-hand use claimed

claims.claim: Zen12 homepage lists beginner and advanced 24 MP3 six-level options
claims.limits: Confirm checkout eligibility for each SKU

claims.claim: Zen12 homepage advertises a one-year money-back guarantee
claims.limits: Not confirmed enforceable on specific referred checkout

claims.claim: Zen12 main catalog premium was advertised at $87.99 when reviewed
claims.limits: Snapshot only, may change

claims.claim: Separate Zen12 secret offer shows different coupon/campaign price
claims.limits: No entitlement to unrelated coupon; excludes countdown claims

claims.claim: Zen12 can deliver an hour's advanced meditation in twelve minutes
claims.limits: Never adopt as fact or implied promise

claims.claim: Zen12 automatically erases stress/anxiety
claims.limits: No health outcome claim

claims.claim: Inspire3 public affiliate portal advertises special earning links and generic payout terms
claims.limits: Generic portal is not account-specific terms

claims.claim: FV is a verified accepted Inspire3 publishing partner
claims.limits: Gmail promotional messages do not establish named partner acceptance

claims.claim: Zen12 product/page is authorized for FV's website and email/social channels
claims.limits: SKU and channel-specific consent absent

claims.claim: FV has an issued earning URL and verified referral checkout
claims.limits: Never invent or activate a link

claims.claim: Affiliate recommendation requires clear conspicuous material connection near earning link
claims.limits: Future disclosure must stay adjacent visually and for screen readers

claims.claim: Objective health-related promotional claims require appropriate substantiation
claims.limits: FTC guide interprets law; adequacy depends on exact claim

claims.claim: An affiliate_click constitutes a paid sale
claims.limits: Independently validated merchant settlement required

claims.claim: Verified revenue per 1000 qualified human sessions can be reported now
claims.limits: No authenticated sales/settlement or qualified denominator

claims.claim: A payable rights-cleared FV-owned Mind digital SKU exists now
claims.limits: Free Focus Fieldbook is not a paid SKU
